description: General contract-relations taxonomy for the document-property discovery experiment. Frozen before evaluation; markers are legal-concept vocabulary, not gold snippets.
provenance: Defined from general legal concepts. Frozen; do not add or change markers after reading results.
freeze_note: v1 was finalized after a smoke test corrected one inflection error (assignment used the passive 'överlåtas' but not the active 'överlåta'). No marker was added from gold coverage numbers.

properties.label: Tillämplig rätt
properties.definition: The contract states which jurisdiction or law governs it.

properties.label: Sekretessplikt
properties.definition: The contract imposes an operative duty of secrecy or non-disclosure.

properties.label: Uppsägningstid
properties.definition: The contract states a notice period or how it may be terminated.

properties.label: Automatisk förlängning
properties.definition: The contract contains a standing tacit or automatic renewal term.

properties.label: Ansvarsbegränsning
properties.definition: The contract caps or excludes damages liability.

properties.label: Undantag från ansvarsbegränsning vid sekretessbrott
properties.definition: A liability limitation does not apply to a breach of secrecy.

properties.label: Befrielsegrund vid oförutsedda händelser
properties.definition: The contract relieves a party for circumstances beyond its control.

properties.label: Personuppgiftsreglering
properties.definition: The contract regulates processing of personal data.

properties.label: Överlåtelseförbud
properties.definition: The contract restricts assignment or transfer of rights.
